title: RATE NOT WALL + DESERT-EXTENDS-TO-CLOUD — r31's resistance is a per-stream lottery draw (3/8 salted streams cross @0.4824), and the canonical stream's whole cloud holds no verify>=0.45 cell in any of 12 gens
directive: Autopsy root 31's lone resistance to tie-band diversity (exp020 crossed 29+37, 31 stayed closed @0.3027): Q1 replicate the exact exp020 tiesample lane on r31 across K=8 salted rng streams (rate vs wall); Q2 passively census EVERY cloud cell's held-out verify per gen on the canonical seed-31 stream (opportunity census, zero rng consumption).

engine.name: micromoth
engine.note: matches the import-baseline manifest pin on main; runner executes against the qcells lab package (labs/qcells), same engine family as exp016-exp020

seeds.q1_salts: rng seed = 31000+k for k=0..7 (8 salted streams, exact exp020 tiesample lane, root 31)
seeds.q2_canonical: rng seed=31 (the exact exp020 stream, rerun as instrumented census; plus one incumbent-arm run seed=31 for contrast)
seeds.panel: root 31 only — the single hard-class root exp020's tiesample arm left closed

question: Why does root 31 alone resist tie-band diversity: is its resistance a per-stream RATE (ROOT-LOTTERY) or an absolute WALL at this panel (Q1), and did the canonical stream ever birth a crossing cell the tie rule failed to pick (Q2)?
design: Q1: K=8 replicates of the exact exp020 tiesample lane on root 31, rng seed=31000+k; no pooling across streams; per-stream N/M honest read. Q2: single instrumented run seed=31 tie_sample=True + one incumbent-arm run seed=31; census records per gen per-candidate train_p and verify_p for EVERY cloud cell (not just the tie band, not just the promoted pick); census evals use p_target's deterministic seeds and consume NO rng draws — the child stream and tie-break sequence are byte-identical to exp020 (census is a passive observer). Lane: targets ('000','111'), mode balance, n_qubits 3, train_seed 101, verify_seed 202, shots 512, gate budget 6, exp004 policy restrict=('replace','indel'), pop 16, gens 12, birth skeleton [['h',0],['cx',0,1]], BAR 0.45. NO archive, NO retention anywhere in this experiment.
pre_run_pin: Q1 pinned BEFORE running: >=1 crossing in 8 salted streams -> RATE NOT WALL (resistance is a per-stream ROOT-LOTTERY draw; exp019 retention verdict for 31 stands on rate grounds, not uniqueness); 0/8 -> WALL AT K=8 POWER (desert read stands absolute at this panel). Q2 pinned BEFORE running, three outcomes: (a) some gen's TIE BAND contains a verify>=0.45 cell -> OPPORTUNITY-MISSED (tie sampling failed to draw an existing crossing cell; rate-supporting); (b) cloud contains a verify>=0.45 cell but NEVER in any tie band -> STRUCTURAL MISMATCH (crossing fitness invisible to gen-max train selection on 31); (c) cloud NEVER contains a verify>=0.45 cell across all 12 gens -> DESERT-EXTENDS-TO-CLOUD (exp016's r31 crossing necessarily assembled fitness ACROSS generations via retention; exp019 RETENTION-ASSEMBLY verdict is the only remaining mechanism).

results.verdict: RATE NOT WALL + DESERT-EXTENDS-TO-CLOUD: 3/8 salted streams crossed r31 @0.4824 (k3/k5/k6) — 31's resistance is a per-stream ROOT-LOTTERY draw, not a wall; and on the canonical seed-31 stream NO cloud cell reached verify>=0.45 in any of 12 gens under either tie arm (max cloud verify = champion itself: 0.3027 tiesample / 0.2422 incumbent, opportunity gens empty in both arms) — the exp016 archive crossing on 31 necessarily assembled fitness ACROSS generations via retention; exp019's RETENTION-ASSEMBLY verdict is the only remaining mechanism.
results.guard_coverage_note: guard pins the instrumented loop (census active) to exp001 byte-identical on the default lane; Q2 arms replicate exp020's r31 finals exactly (exp020_replicate_ok flags in sealed results)

q1_rate_vs_wall.band_verdict: RATE NOT WALL: >=1 crossing in 8 -> the pre-registered RATE band; 3/8 is an N/M rate read per ROOT-LOTTERY, not a law

q2_opportunity_census.band_verdict: DESERT-EXTENDS-TO-CLOUD: outcome (c) of the pre-registered Q2 bands — the cloud NEVER held a verify>=0.45 cell in 12 gens on the canonical stream, in either arm; not opportunity-missed (a), not structural mismatch (b)

honest_limits: N/M, NOT A LAW: 3/8 salted streams crossing r31 is a per-stream draw under ROOT-LOTTERY (exp012); the claim is '31's resistance is rate-explicable', not 'every salted stream crosses'.
k4 NAMED, NOT HIDDEN: seed 31004 peaked 0.418 — the closest non-crosser — reported in the sealed table rather than rounded into the crossers.
k7 DEAD STREAM NAMED: seed 31007 never left 0.0 (birth cloud held nothing all 12 gens) — the desert has a per-stream severity range, stated not smoothed.

GUARD COVERAGE STATED: the guard reproduces exp001 on the default lane with the census instrument active; the Q2 arms diverge from the guard lane by definition (tie_sample=True) and are covered only by the exp020 replicate_ok flags, stated pre-run.
CENSUS IS PASSIVE: census evals consume no rng draws; the child stream and tie-break sequence are byte-identical to exp020's r31 runs — the instrument observed, never steered.
SINGLE PANEL: Q1 replicates only root 31 (the exp020 holdout); no claim is made about 29/37's stream rates from this experiment.
